description: Permanently delete the copy of the old data that a restore set aside, freeing that disk on the server. Pass the RESTORE job's id (the one whose replaced_path is set). Irreversible, and it is the customer's safety net for a restore they may still want to undo — so only call it once they have confirmed the restored app is the one they want.

backup_id.description: The restore job that set data aside.

name: impreza_discard_replaced
title: Discard replaced app data
